specs.Compatible Devices: Gaming Console, Laptop, Smartphone, Speaker, Tablet

features: Official Google TV Integration: Wzatco Yuva Horizon projector features official Google TV with WideVine L1 certification for high resolution streaming. Delivers clarity across certified apps like Netflix, Prime Video, Zee5, SonyLIV, and Hotstar. Includes Google Cast for seamless mirroring and Google Assistant voice control via Bluetooth remote for smart entertainment

1500 ANSI Brightness with Sealed Engine and Native 1080P: Engineered with 1500 ANSI brightness and Advanced Sealed Optical Engine. Features native 1080P resolution with 4K support and 99% color gamut for rich, lifelike visuals. Reduced blue light and enhanced dark-scene detail ensure comfortable viewing even in brighter rooms for movies, gaming, outdoor parties, and live sports

Fully Automatic Setup with Intelligent Sensors: Wzatco Horizon features intelligent Auto Focus, Auto Keystone, and Auto Screen Fit technology with 100% to 50% zoom capability. Auto Focus delivers instant sharpness, Auto Keystone ensures alignment, and Screen Fit automatically adjusts the screen to the confines of the projector screen for a seamless, hands-free experience

Advanced Rotatable Design with Built-in Stand: Premium rotatable body and built-in stand allow smooth angle adjustments for flexible projection positioning. Smart design meets effortless setup for convenient installation in any space

Medium Throw Ratio 1.3:1 for Flexible Placement: With a throw ratio of 1.3:1, Horizon delivers a large, immersive display from a relatively short distance. Provides cinematic scale without complicated placement, offering maximum flexibility and a clutter-free setup in any room

Warranty Coverage and Support: Nationwide warranty coverage with 1-Year warranty from the date of purchase. Product registration is mandatory to avail warranty benefits. Visit the company website for additional details on warranty terms and conditions

Connectivity Options: Equipped with WiFi 6 and Bluetooth 5.4 for fast wireless connectivity. Features ARC, HDMI, and USB ports for versatile connection options with various devices and audio systems for enhanced home theater experience
